name: Cetaphil Baby Daily Lotion 400ml with Shea Butter Vitamin E
description:
Keep your baby’s skin soft, smooth, and nourished with Cetaphil Baby Daily Lotion. Enriched with shea butter, vitamin E, soybean oil, sunflower oil, and glycerin, this gentle lotion provides all-day hydration for dry and sensitive skin.

Key Features:

Brand: Cetaphil

Scent: Shea Butter

Form: Lotion

Active Ingredients: Soybean oil, sunflower oil, glycerin, shea butter

Use: Whole body

Suitable For: Dry and sensitive skin

Special Features: Oil-free, gentle, and safe for daily use

Net Quantity: 400ml

Made in Germany
